name: obsidian-notion-sync
description: Share Obsidian notes via Notion and incrementally back up & restore entire vaults.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@obsidian-notion-sync/core && npm run build --workspace=@obsidian-notion-sync/plugin && npm run build --workspace=@obsidian-notion-sync/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@obsidian-notion-sync/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@obsidian-notion-sync/plugin && npm run typecheck --workspace=@obsidian-notion-sync/cli
